# LectQA-Vid — acquisition coverage

Source: the Mendeley record (doi:10.17632/yt4nmz9mcv.1, CC BY 4.0) ships the QA pairs and YouTube links only ("videos, keyframes and transcripts are not provided because of copyright issues"), so every video comes from YouTube: audio m4a + 360p video-only mp4, fetched with yt-dlp. Transcripts are ours: faster-whisper, sentence-split, frozen on first run.
